question: Why should students be reminded to Restart & Run All before submitting a lab or quiz?

answers.answer: Re-running cells out of order can leave stale variable values that make the notebook look correct but not actually run correctly top-to-bottom
answers.feedback: Correct — this is especially important on quizzes/labs with locking behavior, where a fresh run may behave differently than the cached state.

answers.answer: It automatically fixes any incorrect answers
answers.feedback: Restart & Run All doesn't fix wrong answers — it just ensures the notebook's stored outputs reflect a clean, in-order execution.

answers.answer: It is required by Python syntax rules
answers.feedback: This isn't a language requirement — it's a practical safeguard against out-of-order execution bugs.

answers.feedback: It reruns the code from a clean kernel — it doesn't delete anything.
